text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
*gasp*... *wheeze*... That was 
exhausting... A 3,200m GⅠ...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"I'm totally... the champion of 
exhaustion... But..."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
YAAAAAAAY!!!!!!! I did it, I did it, I did 
itttttt!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The stayer talent acknowledged even by 
Narita Top Road. It has now—truly erupted.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a fantastic race execution that 
called to mind that stellar run in the 
Kikuka Sho, but...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Thank goodness... I'm so, so relieved...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
So it doesn't count as a lie when I told 
you I'd "win", Trainer~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even the reason behind her relief was so 
characteristically Hishi Miracle.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Miracle-san, once again, what was 
the key to your victory?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
The reason for victory... you say? Even if 
you ask me that~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... The reason I was able to 
win...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I guess maybe I had a bit of talent as a 
stayer. I don't panic even over long 
distances, after all.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
And the "resolve" to stake it all on the 
race...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...Maybe just a tiny bit. I mean, it's 
not like I don't feel it at all."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Though in exchange for less resolve... 
hehe.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Go! Do your best!" "You've got this!" 
"You're definitely gonna win!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"There's someone who's always encouraging 
me like that, you see. I suppose half of 
it is thanks to them."

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
I see! Then riding this momentum, our next 
race will be—

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
"The Takarazuka Kinen?! That's the 
fan-voted Grand Prix held in June, isn't 
it?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Takarazuka... Kinen...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Um, which Umamusume are entering hasn't 
been decided yet, right?

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Nothing is officially set yet. However, 
several of the top contenders have already 
declared their intention to run.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
First up is Symboli Kris S. Next is the 
fast-rising, swashbuckling romantic, Tap 
Dance City.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Also, the all-rounder who doesn't care 
whether it's turf or dirt, Agnes 
Digital-san, said she wants to run too.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Kris S-chan, Tap-chan, and Digital-chan~?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Isn't that an absolute all-star lineup?

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Yes, though quite a few Umamusume opted to 
skip this year's Tenno Sho (Spring)...

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
The Takarazuka Kinen has a star-studded 
lineup. What do you say, are you willing 
to enter?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Y-You can't ask me that right after the 
race finished~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"W-Wait, for now... I'll have to talk it 
over with my Trainer first~!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Waaaaaaah, Trainerrrrr...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The winner, Hishi Miracle, returned 
shedding tears, though not quite tears of 
joy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Later on, I decided to review the reasons 
behind this victory and outline our 
outlook for the next race.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, as expected, having the right 
distance played a huge role in the Tenno 
Sho (Spring)~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Since girls strong at middle distance like 
Kris S-chan withdrew, the competition 
isn't as tough. But...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
The Takarazuka Kinen is totally different, 
right? The distance suits the other girls 
way better~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: And, and what's more, Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"While doing the interview, a thought 
crossed my mind... Am I actually cheating 
here in the first place?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yes~. I still don't quite have enough 
"resolve," but to make up for what I 
lack...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer fills in that gap for me by 
cheering me on with 'Go, go, give it your 
all!'

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Against the Takarazuka Kinen lineup, maybe 
she really is just a tier below...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
In the first place, Trainer, if you teamed 
up with another Umamusume, wouldn't they 
end up becoming the strongest?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I hold back before falling into a spiral 
of self-doubt.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
First, it was crucial to get Hishi Miracle 
to believe in her own abilities.
choice_data_list: You're a Tenno Sho Umamusume, right?
You're a Tenno Sho Uma Musume, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Indeed. That is how it turned out.
choice_data_list:
A girl who isn't strong could win? The 
Tenno Sho?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I... don't think I can win. It's such an 
incredible race.
choice_data_list:
You're already on the same level as 
Symboli Kris S, you know?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it... She's the Tenno Sho 
Autumn girl, and I'm the Spring girl...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ehehehe, oh you~ Flattering me again~
choice_data_list:
I believed in you... and that's why we 
teamed up.

I believed in you just like that... that's 
why I put this together

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Geez... That's not fair~. Dropping 
something like that out of nowhere...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"I can win... Even against Kris S-chan, 
Tap-chan, Digital-chan, that whole 
star-studded lineup..."
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's prove who's the strongest.
Yeah, let's prove you're the strongest.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"At the very least, there is no way an 
Umamusume who won the Tenno Sho (Spring) 
would be completely outclassed in the 
Takarazuka Kinen."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My job as a Trainer was to raise her 
spirits no matter what and lead her all 
the way to the real thing.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, if you're going to say that much, 
Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Even up until now, I've always been wrong 
and Trainer has always been right.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Understood...! Well then, please keep 
pushing me hard, okay?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Instead of resolve, I've got everyone's 
support! I won't be crushed! Yeah—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Miracle spurred herself on. And so, 
she somehow resolved to head toward the 
dream showdown, the Takarazuka Kinen.
